scope: All81 canonical issues currently recorded in the one master, including historical, partial and unsupported records. Later discoveries do not alter this fixed denominator.
countingRule: Count a baseline issue only after all applicable context scopes satisfy its retained criteria and current validated closure evidence. Duplicate, historical, excluded, partial, source-reviewed, locally improved or merged alone do not count as fixes.

acceptance: Matched elevation-plane views with girdle/humeral/axial-rotation traces, plausible skin and reference-supported task coordination.
